name: Personal Training
shortDescription: One-on-one coaching designed around your strength, mobility, and wellness goals.
description: Personal training sessions combine individualized exercise programming, encouragement, and intentional goal setting to help you build lasting strength and confidence.
bestFor: Strength, mobility, accountability, and personalized fitness support

name: Strength Foundations
shortDescription: Build confidence with safe and effective foundational strength training.
description: Strength Foundations introduces proper movement patterns, resistance exercises, and progressive training techniques for clients beginning or rebuilding a fitness routine.
bestFor: Beginners and clients returning to exercise

name: Guided Outdoor Fitness
shortDescription: Improve endurance and reconnect with creation through guided outdoor movement.
description: Guided outdoor fitness combines walking, hiking, bodyweight exercises, and mindful movement in an outdoor setting.
bestFor: Cardiovascular health, endurance, and outdoor activity

name: Body Composition Scan
shortDescription: Track meaningful wellness measurements beyond the number on a scale.
description: Body composition scanning provides useful measurements that can help clients understand progress and establish realistic wellness goals.

name: Mobility & Recovery
shortDescription: Improve flexibility, movement quality, and recovery through guided mobility work.
description: Mobility and recovery sessions focus on gentle movement, stretching, and recovery techniques that support healthy movement patterns.

name: Nutrition Coaching
shortDescription: Develop realistic nutrition habits that support your personal wellness goals.
description: Nutrition coaching provides practical guidance for building sustainable eating habits while supporting energy, wellness, and long-term consistency.
bestFor: Healthy eating habits and personalized nutrition guidance

name: Personal Wellness Planning
shortDescription: Create an approachable nutrition and wellness plan designed around your lifestyle.
description: Personal wellness planning brings together goals, routines, food choices, and daily habits to create a practical wellness strategy.
bestFor: Clients seeking structure and sustainable routines

name: Meal Planning Support
shortDescription: Simplify healthy eating with practical meal-planning strategies.
description: Meal planning support helps clients develop organized, realistic approaches to grocery planning, preparation, and balanced meal choices.

name: Protein & Supplement Guidance
shortDescription: Learn how protein and wellness supplements may fit into a balanced nutrition routine.
description: This educational consultation reviews general protein needs and supplement considerations while emphasizing food-first wellness habits.
bestFor: Clients interested in nutrition products and general supplementation education

name: Healthy Habit Coaching
shortDescription: Turn wellness goals into consistent daily habits that are easier to maintain.
description: Healthy Habit Coaching focuses on realistic behavior changes involving meals, hydration, movement, rest, and personal accountability.

name: Foot Reflexology
shortDescription: Experience a calming wellness practice focused on relaxation and restorative care.
description: Foot reflexology sessions use gentle pressure techniques designed to promote relaxation and provide a peaceful wellness experience.

name: Guided Breathwork
shortDescription: Practice intentional breathing techniques that encourage calm and focused awareness.
description: Guided breathwork teaches simple breathing exercises that can support relaxation, reflection, and intentional moments of stillness.

name: Faith-Centered Meditation
shortDescription: Create space for peaceful reflection through guided Christian meditation.
description: Faith-centered meditation combines quiet reflection, guided breathing, scripture-centered thoughts, and intentional moments of gratitude.

name: Mindful Wellness Coaching
shortDescription: Develop routines that encourage balance, reflection, and purposeful living.
description: Mindful Wellness Coaching helps clients examine routines and wellness habits while developing intentional practices that support balance and personal growth.
bestFor: Life balance, mindfulness, and personal wellness routines

name: Whole-Person Wellness Session
shortDescription: Explore physical, emotional, and spiritual wellness goals in one integrated session.
description: The Whole-Person Wellness Session provides an opportunity to discuss multiple areas of wellness and identify practical next steps that support body, mind, and spirit.
bestFor: Clients who want an integrated approach to wellness
